definition.en: Monetary Policy refers to the set of actions taken by a central bank to manage the money supply and interest rates to achieve macroeconomic objectives like price stability and economic growth.
definition.hi: Monetary Policy refers to the set of actions taken by a central bank to manage the money supply and interest rates to achieve macroeconomic objectives like price stability and economic growth.

importanceInUpsc.en: Monetary Policy is a core component of the UPSC GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section. Understanding this topic is essential for analyzing how the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) influences inflation, liquidity, and overall economic stability in India.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Monetary Policy is a core component of the UPSC GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section. Understanding this topic is essential for analyzing how the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) influences inflation, liquidity, and overall economic stability in India.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the objectives and instruments of Monetary Policy in the Indian context.
